diagnosis.proven_failure: Addition raw-gradient positivity assertion at helper line161, after whole-support two training iterations.
diagnosis.clipping_order: Hooks append gradients during loss.backward before clip_grad_norm_(...,0.1) and optimizer.step. Clipping cannot directly zero the already-recorded current-step hook value; it may affect later parameters/gradients.
diagnosis.concrete_unconfirmed_path: ExtremalSpanMixer output is zero initialized and hard-clamped into [0,1] (source/extremal_span_mixer.py:25-27,97-102). An inactive clamped branch is a code-grounded diagnostic candidate; actual raw gates and failed group/step are not logged, so it is not established as the cause.
read_only_recommendations: First emit existing per-step gradient_norms/loss_records and groupwise parameter deltas before the failing assertions, preserving a failure diagnostic artifact. This locates the failing category/step and separates optimizer.step invocation from actual parameter changes.

Record native returned grad_total_norm and per-category gradients immediately before/after existing clipping, plus each step raw span gate min/max and <=0/>=1 counts. Keep B8, seed2027, LR, clipping, objective and optimizer behavior unchanged during diagnosis.

Do not remove the failing assertion, disable clipping, alter LR or change the gate solely to obtain a pass. If direct measurements establish a legitimate inactive clamped second batch, while the first batch has nonzero activity and the two-step group delta is nonzero, assess an across-probe activity requirement rather than requiring positive activity in every individual batch; that conclusion is conditional and not a current fix authorization.
Only fix a proven numerical/dataflow defect after the raw diagnostic identifies it. Current logs do not distinguish a dormant gate, support path issue or a norm-measurement issue.
